rationale: C24 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. It is an immediately preceding regulation under the same Career Compensation Act for additional pay of uniformed-service members, and it uses a closely parallel framework: define qualifying duty, establish entitlement conditions and exclusions, authorize the Secretaries concerned to issue supplementary regulations, require interservice uniformity to the fullest extent practicable, and state an effective date. The unusually close language of the supplementary-regulations clause, combined with the shared entitlement machinery and sequence, exceeds mere topical similarity or isolated boilerplate. C25 and C21 contain related language and machinery but are less extensive matches.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Enlisted members entitled to receive basic pay shall be entitled to receive, additionally, sea-duty pay while on sea duty as defined in section 2 hereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Members who, pursuant to competent orders, are attached to a submarine which is in an active status... shall be entitled to receive incentive pay for the performance of submarine duty.
shared_material.explanation: Both establish additional-pay entitlement by defining a qualifying form of uniformed-service duty and tying entitlement to specified duty conditions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretaries concerned... are hereby authorized to prescribe such supplementary regulations, not inconsistent herewith, as they may deem necessary or desirable for carrying out these regulations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretaries concerned are hereby authorized to prescribe such supplementary regulations not inconsistent herewith as they may deem necessary or desirable for carrying out these regulations
shared_material.explanation: This is nearly verbatim shared delegation language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: such supplementary regulations shall be uniform for all the services to the fullest extent practicable.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: such supplementary regulations shall be uniform for all the services to the fullest extent practicable.
shared_material.explanation: The identical interservice-uniformity requirement reinforces direct reuse of the regulatory drafting framework.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This order shall become effective on November 1, 1950.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This order shall become effective on September 1, 1950
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude the same regulatory structure with a specifically dated effectiveness provision.
